accent-light.purpose: Light-theme primary actions, focus, selection, and dependency strokes.

accent-dark.purpose: Dark-theme primary actions, focus, selection, and dependency strokes.

surface-light.purpose: Light-theme readable planes and selected controls.

surface-dark.purpose: Dark-theme readable planes and selected controls.

glass-light.purpose: Light-theme structural glass, controls, fields, and floating menus.

glass-dark.purpose: Dark-theme structural glass, controls, fields, and floating menus.

material-glow-start-light.purpose: Light-theme start of the restrained material-plane background glow.

material-glow-end-light.purpose: Light-theme end of the restrained material-plane background glow.

material-glow-start-dark.purpose: Dark-theme low-opacity start of the material-plane background glow.

material-glow-end-dark.purpose: Dark-theme low-opacity end of the material-plane background glow.

selected-light.purpose: Light-theme selected queue and navigation states.

selected-dark.purpose: Dark-theme selected queue and navigation states.

danger-light.purpose: Light-theme error text and destructive-action emphasis.

danger-dark.purpose: Dark-theme error text and destructive-action emphasis.

control-line.purpose: Shared outline for board fields, selects, checkboxes, and controls.

body.purpose: Compact readable text across the language board and product surfaces.

page-title.purpose: The current Read-mode board heading and equivalent top-level surface title.

section-title.purpose: The explicit material-and-typography section heading and semantic material-plane title at 20px.

mono.purpose: Reserved for code, operation previews, and preformatted detail; board numeric samples use system text with tabular figures.

shadows.name: material-shadow
shadows.purpose: Restrained depth for the board's material plane and glass relationship.

shadows.name: selected-segment
shadows.purpose: Active option inside a tonal segmented control or theme switch.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: Front-layer cue for a glass select menu or popup.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button, field, and selected-control state transitions.

motion.name: menu-enter
motion.purpose: Brief opacity and blur settling for a floating menu.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Stack the board and raise interactive controls to the 44px mobile target.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Explicit approval, send, create, or other committed action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #305ac7); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #305ac7) 92%, var(--ink, #20314b)); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #305ac7) 84%, var(--ink, #20314b)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #305ac7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--soft, #e6edf6); color: var(--muted, #4c5c73); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: A non-primary response such as denial or navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #7285a5); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #20314b); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--soft, #e6edf6); } .ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--selected, #d4e0f2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #305ac7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: var(--soft, #e6edf6); color: var(--muted, #4c5c73); border-color: transparent; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Glass Input
components.description: Search and selection field with a translucent glass surface.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-glass" type="search" placeholder="Search conversations" aria-label="Search conversations">
components.css: .ds-input-glass { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #7285a5); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--glass, #f2f7ffc2); color: var(--ink, #20314b); caret-color: var(--accent, #305ac7); font: inherit; } .ds-input-glass::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #4c5c73); opacity: 1; } .ds-input-glass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #305ac7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input-glass[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--danger, #a72d41); } input[type="search"] { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; } input[type="search"]::-webkit-search-cancel-button { -webkit-appearance: none; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-input-glass { min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Select Trigger and Menu
components.description: Authored select trigger and glass listbox menu with explicit keyboard states.
components.css: .ds-select-trigger { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #7285a5); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--glass, #f2f7ffc2); color: var(--ink, #20314b); text-align: left; } .ds-select-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #305ac7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-select-menu { padding: 5px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--glass, #f2f7ffc2); box-shadow: var(--shadow), inset 0 1px 0 var(--highlight); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); } .ds-select-menu [role="option"] { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #20314b); text-align: left; } .ds-select-menu [role="option"]:hover, .ds-select-menu [role="option"]:focus-visible { background: var(--soft, #e6edf6); outline: none; } .ds-select-menu [aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--selected, #d4e0f2); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-select-trigger, .ds-select-menu [role="option"] { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Selection Controls
components.description: Checkbox and switch controls with stable selected, disabled, and touch states.
components.css: .ds-check, .ds-switch { min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink, #20314b); } .ds-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-check input { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #7285a5); border-radius: 4px; margin: 0; background: var(--surface, #f6f9fff2); display: grid; place-content: center; } .ds-check input:checked { background: var(--accent, #305ac7); border-color: transparent; } .ds-check input::before { content: ""; width: 9px; height: 5px; border: solid var(--accent-ink, #fff); border-width: 0 0 1.6px 1.6px; transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(1px, -1px); visibility: hidden; } .ds-check input:checked::before { visibility: visible; } .ds-check input:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-check:has(input:disabled) { color: var(--muted, #4c5c73); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; } .ds-switch-track { width: 34px; height: 20px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--control-line, #7285a5); position: relative; } .ds-switch-track::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface, #f6f9fff2); transform: translateX(0); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-switch-track { background: var(--accent, #305ac7); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-switch-track::before { background: var(--accent-ink, #fff); transform: translateX(14px); }

components.name: Status Labels and Feedback
components.description: Text-first semantic statuses and empty, loading, and error feedback states.
components.html: SavedNeeds attentionError
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 26px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--soft, #e6edf6); color: var(--muted, #4c5c73); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-status.success { background: var(--success-bg, #deeee7); color: var(--success, #285f4c); } .ds-status.warning { background: var(--warning-bg, #f7ead5); color: var(--warning, #895211); } .ds-status.error { background: var(--danger-bg, #f8e5e9); color: var(--danger, #a72d41); }

narrative.overview:
The current D01 language board treats Loomhelm as a live working desk: blue-tinted glass separates structural layers from an almost opaque reading plane, while paired light and dark roles keep the same hierarchy legible. The implementation is restrained and operational, using fine highlights, compact controls, authored line icons, and explicit states.

`design/ui-language.html` is the current Read-mode authority and `design/index.html` redirects to it. The task/workbench prototype remains structural reference only, and the complete UI is not approved. D, Glass / Layered and its paired light/dark direction remain owner-pinned; board palette and interaction refinements are language-board implementation details, not additional owner approvals. The system is authored directly in HTML and CSS.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-tinted glass structural layers with a readable, nearly opaque surface.
Paired light and dark semantic roles with the same information hierarchy.
Compact controls, authored SVG line icons, and restrained layered depth.
Clear selection, readable fields, popup menus, and explicit feedback states.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Keep the same semantic roles, hierarchy, and readable states in both themes; change the material values, not the information architecture.

rules.name: The System Text Rule
rules.body: Use the system stack for prose and controls, and monospace for operation previews. Apply the recorded heading tracking only to the corresponding heading role.

rules.name: The Layered Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation, material glow, and fine highlights first; reserve ambient shadows for material planes, selected controls, and floating menus.

dos: Do keep light and dark roles paired so the same content, control, and state distinctions remain readable.
Do keep the reading surface almost opaque and reserve glass blur for structural layers and floating menus.
Do use authored inline SVG line icons and CSS; this board has no shipping raster UI assets.
Do use 38px desktop buttons, 42px inputs/selects, and 44px mobile interactive targets.
Do suppress animation and transitions when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active.
donts: Don't carry rejected neutral, journal, standard, or other exploratory direction rules into the selected glass system.
Don't turn the prototype's queue, request, or recent-conversation arrangement into universal component guidance.
Don't make reading surfaces fully transparent or use heavy permanent shadows that compete with the work.
Don't apply heading tracking to prose, labels, or metadata that are not heading roles.
Don't claim this board proves the complete UI, backend behavior, synchronization, authorization, or product approval.
